inputs.taskText: Dana, owner of a yoga studio, is looking for a designer to redesign the studio’s landing page in Figma: one page, mobile version, booking form. Deadline: 3 weeks. Budget: $600.
inputs.freelancerPositioning: Web designer, 6 years. I design landing pages in Figma for small service businesses (a dental clinic, a fitness studio). I hand over a mobile version and a clickable prototype; two revision rounds included.

example.intro: A short brief plus a profile with checkable facts gives a proposal like this one:
example.output:
Hi Dana,

A landing page for a yoga studio where booking has to be easy is right up my alley: I design landing pages in Figma for small service businesses, most recently a fitness studio and a dental clinic. For your page I would deliver the desktop and mobile layouts with the booking form and a clickable prototype within your three weeks and the $600 budget, with two revision rounds included.

If that works for you, send me your current page and brand materials and I will come back with a plan for the first week.
